contradictory_evidence: UNESCO inscription supports recognition and safeguarding, but it is not evidence that practitioners have stable income, that transmission is secure, or that every local school survived.

Calling Mal7oun exclusively urban or tying it to one city can erase circulation among Meknes, Fes, Marrakech, Salé and other communities; a single-origin claim needs manuscript and performance evidence.
Official heritage language may emphasize continuity, while living performers may report change, hybrid instruments or pressures; no current practitioner interviews were retrieved for this run.
uncertainty: Low on the 2023 UNESCO inscription; medium on broad historical genealogy; high on the present 2026 condition of transmission and livelihoods because live retrieval and interviews failed.
